service.description: Retrieves active Meta-JSON layout tree, falling back to disk or invalidating stale buffer if physical file was modified.
Stores or updates a Meta-JSON workspace layout buffer safely.
Recursively processes FreeMarker templates (.ftl) by expanding include directives, or converts a layoutTree AST map into standard Moqui screen XML adhering to xml-screen-3.xsd.
Compiles the Meta-JSON blueprint layout tree back into standard Moqui XML, validates against xml-screen-3.xsd, and writes it cleanly formatted to disk.
Renders a Moqui XML screen file off disk into native QMETA Meta-JSON AST using DefaultScreenMacros.qmeta.ftl and stamps canonical mariaIds.
Scans runtime component directories to discover all XML screens, Groovy services, entities, tests, and reports with fully preserved nested relative paths.
Deletes the in-memory/DB workspace buffer for an artifact or all artifacts for the current user.
Purges an artifact file from disk, deletes its DB workspace buffer, and clears screen/resource caches.
